# OPDF

> A PDF workspace for viewing, editing, annotating, organizing, and converting PDF documents.

OPDF runs as a web application, a self-hosted server application, and a desktop application. Some operations depend on the deployment mode and user permissions. PDF document contents may be private.

## Public links

- [OPDF source code](https://github.com/ttha711/Opdf)
- [Usage and setup](https://github.com/ttha711/Opdf/blob/main/README.md)

## Safe automation guidance

- Use the visible application controls and authenticated, documented interfaces only.
- Ask the user before modifying, signing, deleting, sharing, or uploading documents.
- Do not infer access to a user's files from this public metadata.
- No privileged API credentials, internal automation endpoints, or authentication tokens are published here.
